title: cardamine raphanifolia subsp. merinoi
intro: Cardamine raphanifolia subsp. merinoi, commonly known as the Spanish toothwort, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its antiseptic and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine raphanifolia subsp. merinoi include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
